subject: PilotRetail live chat: high-latency on streaming endpoint — coordinated mitigation plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Torres <kai@pilotretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PilotRetail live chat: high-latency on streaming endpoint — immediate mitigations

Hi Kai —

Thanks for flagging the live-chat slowness this morning. We can confirm a subset of streaming/chat requests routed through our us-west region experienced elevated per-token latency between 08:40–09:05 PST, which can manifest as delayed first tokens and chunking in the UI. We understand this impacts your checkout-support flow during peak traffic.

Short-term actions you can apply immediately (low lift):
- Switch to non-streaming responses as a temporary fallback: set streaming=false in your /v1/chat calls. This will increase tail latency in some cases but prevents partial token stalls.
- Reduce max_tokens to 256 on the request to limit long-tail generation blocking.
- If you rely on resume tokens, add retry with exponential backoff and idempotent dedup keys (we recommend 250ms -> 1s window).

We are also performing the following from our side:
- Increasing autoscaling headroom for your Dedicated pool in us-west for the next 60 minutes.
- Applying a temporary routing override to prefer the us-east cluster for new sessions (you do not need to change settings).
- Increasing KV cache retention for your model shard to improve cold-start behavior.

I attached a short troubleshooting checklist and a snapshot of the KPIs we pulled for your account. Please reply with any immediate impact metrics (drop in conversions, number of affected sessions) so we can prioritize.

I will keep you updated and loop in Engineering with a deeper post-incident remediation plan.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: livechat-troubleshoot-checklist.pdf, pilotretail-kpi-snapshot-1215.csv

From: Kai Torres <kai@pilotretail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Adrian Mills <adrian.mills@pilotretail.com>, Procurement <procurement@pilotretail.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:25:31 -0800
Subject: Re: PilotRetail live chat: high-latency on streaming endpoint — immediate mitigations

Thanks Jasmine —

We saw the same behavior on our end (customers reporting long pauses mid-message). We can flip to non-streaming for the most critical support flows, but that will remove progressive rendering in our UI. Two quick asks from our team: 1) how long will the routing override to us-east remain in place, and 2) can you confirm whether this impacts any account-level quotas?

Impact: approx 430 sessions affected between 08:45–09:00 PST; ~1.2% checkout abandonment upstream. I attached a short log export from our web client showing repeated reconnections.

-Kai

On Tue, Dec 15, 2026 at 09:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:03:14 -0800
Subject: RE: PilotRetail live chat: high-latency on streaming endpoint — immediate mitigations

Jasmine / Team —

Thanks for the quick heads-up. Engineering notes from the triage channel: a subset of edge connections in us-west hit a queuing spike after an autoscaler mis-evaluated a memory pressure signal during the 08:30–09:00 window. That produced delayed token emission even though generation was progressing on the backend kernel. We pushed two mitigations at 09:00: tightened autoscaler thresholds and deployed a hotfix to the streaming buffer flush path.

Customer-facing guidance to reduce user friction while we validate the fix:
- Use the API param "streaming=false" for critical flows (as Jasmine suggested).
- If you must keep streaming, set chunk_timeout to 800ms (default 1500ms) so the client triggers partial flushes more aggressively.
- As a temporary experiment, route new sessions to us-east by setting the api_region header to "us-east-1"; we'll keep our override for 90 minutes and monitor.

I will attach the short incident log once sanitized. Laura, can you coordinate a one-hour credit for the affected window with Billing? Marissa, flagging this for leadership visibility given the customer-reported conversion impact.

Ben
SR Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:12:47 -0800
Subject: RE: PilotRetail live chat: high-latency on streaming endpoint — immediate mitigations

Ben / Jasmine —

Thanks — I drafted a quick credit proposal for PilotRetail: a 1-hour service credit on peak usage during the incident window plus a waived overage for the month if they saw >1% conversion impact. Draft below; I will send the formal billing adjustment once Jasmine approves wording to the customer.

Customer note (proposal):
"We understand the disruption caused by this morning's streaming latency spike. Redwood is providing a one-hour service credit for the affected period and will waive any overage fees generated in December as a gesture of goodwill if PilotRetail confirms conversion impact exceeded 1%. We will follow up with a technical postmortem and remediation timeline by EOD."

Logan, please confirm the incident tracker link and any escalation tickets you want added to the customer follow-up.

—Laura
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: PilotRetail: incident summary and next steps (EOD follow-up)

Team / Kai (cc’d where appropriate) —

Summary (short):
- Incident window: 2026-12-15 08:40–09:05 PST.
- Root cause (preliminary): autoscaler threshold mis-evaluation + streaming buffer flush regression under memory pressure.
- Customer impact: increased per-token latency and partial chunk stalls; PilotRetail reports ~430 sessions affected and ~1.2% checkout uplift in abandonment.

Immediate actions completed:
- Autoscaler thresholds corrected and hotfix deployed at ~09:00 PST.
- Temporary routing override to us-east for new sessions (kept active until 10:30 PST, then reverted after monitoring).
- Customer notified and recommended API-level mitigations (streaming=false, reduce max_tokens, chunk_timeout adjustment).
- Billing proposed a one-hour credit and conditional overage waiver.

Next steps (owners):
- Engineering (Logan): full postmortem with timeline and code/metric diffs — deliverable by 2026-12-17 EOD.
- Product/Runtime (Ben): evaluate permanent autoscaler threshold adjustments and add a regression test for the streaming buffer under memory pressure — deliverable 2027-01-07.
- CS (Laura/Jasmine): finalize customer-facing postmortem and send by 2026-12-16 17:00 PST.

Customer-facing language is ready for review; Jasmine, please send the EOD note to Kai with the proposed credit and attach the sanitized incident log. Keep us posted if PilotRetail wants a technical walk-through.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
